ideas.children_he: עַבְדֵי ה׳ הָעוֹמְדִים בְּבֵיתוֹ בַּלַּיְלָה נִקְרָאִים לְבָרֵךְ אוֹתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: God's servants standing in His house at night are called to bless Him.

ideas.children_he: הֵם מֻזְמָנִים לְהָרִים יָדַיִם אֶל הַקֹּדֶשׁ בִּתְפִלָּה וּבִבְרָכָה.
ideas.children_en: They are invited to raise their hands toward the holy place in prayer and blessing.

ideas.children_he: הַמְשׁוֹרֵר מְבָרֵךְ שֶׁעוֹשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ יְבָרֵךְ אֶת עֲבָדָיו מִצִּיּוֹן.
ideas.children_en: The psalmist asks the maker of heaven and earth to bless His servants from Zion.
